status: ANALYTIC_COUNTEREXAMPLE TO ENTROPY-ONLY FLUX CONTROL; NO HYDRODYNAMIC THEOREM COUNTEREXAMPLE

claims.claim: There are smooth positive probability densities f_eps on R^3 with exactly the same mass, momentum, and kinetic energy as the unit Maxwellian M, such that H(f_eps|M)=O(eps^3)=o(eps^2), but integral |v|^2 v f_eps dv tends to e_1 rather than 0.
claims.construction: f_eps=(1-delta_eps)N(b_eps e_1,s_eps^2 I_3)+delta_eps N(R_eps e_1,I_3), with R_eps=eps^-3, delta_eps=eps^9, b_eps=-delta_eps R_eps/(1-delta_eps), c_eps=eps^3, and s_eps^2=1-c_eps/[3(1-delta_eps)]-c_eps^2/[3R_eps^2(1-delta_eps)^2].
claims.falsifier: An algebraic recalculation showing failure of exact moment matching, H/eps^2 -> 0, or the stated third-moment limit.

claims.claim: The entropy bound H(f|M) alone does not imply uniform integrability of cubic velocity moments, even with exact mass, momentum, and energy matching; in the scaled fluctuation g_eps=(f_eps/M-1)/eps, the signed cubic flux diverges like eps^-1.
claims.evidence: RESULT.txt Sections 1 and 2; relative-entropy Young inequality has Gaussian-dual growth at most quadratic in velocity.
claims.scope: This is an obstruction to an entropy-only implication/proof step. It is not evidence that an actual Boltzmann solution violates a hydrodynamic limit.

claims.claim: A Gaussian exponential moment on the absolute scaled fluctuation, sup_eps integral exp(a|v|^2)|g_eps|M dv < infinity for 0<a<1/2, is sufficient to give uniform integrability of the cubic flux and pass it under bounded-velocity weak convergence.
claims.evidence: RESULT.txt Section 3: tail bounded by C sup_{r>L} r^3 exp(-a r^2), which tends to zero.
claims.scope: Sufficient, not necessary; differs from the weighted L2 tail condition in Saint-Raymond (2009).

claims.claim: The explicit family does not refute Saint-Raymond's 2009 Boltzmann-to-incompressible-Euler theorem because the theorem assumes an additional large-velocity bound and the family is specified only as initial data, without a time-evolution counterexample.
claims.evidence: Saint-Raymond (2009), Theorem 2.1 condition (2.3), Remark 2.2(i), and Section 2.1 discussion of the cubic energy flux; see READ_LEDGER.txt.
claims.falsifier: An actual solution family satisfying the full stated theorem assumptions while violating its conclusion, or a verified proof that the constructed data satisfy the theorem's tail condition.

open_work: Determine whether the homogeneous Boltzmann collision evolution removes this flux in an initial layer or whether any time-integrated obstruction remains under entropy alone.
Compare the precise additional tail assumption across later Boltzmann hydrodynamic-limit theorems before making broader claims.
